name: integration-workflow
description: iPaaS on Logic Apps Standard with a Service Bus messaging backbone, keyless connectors via managed identity, and App Insights monitoring.
what: A Logic Apps Standard plan hosting stateful and stateless workflows, paired with a Service Bus namespace (inbound/outbound queues with dead-lettering). The Logic App authenticates to Service Bus with its managed identity (local auth disabled), and workflow telemetry flows to Application Insights.
why: Integration teams stitch SaaS, on-prem, and Azure systems together and need a managed, versionable workflow runtime with durable messaging - without standing up BizTalk or bespoke middleware. Logic Apps Standard plus Service Bus delivers that with identity-based, audited connectivity.
potentialUseCases: B2B / EDI message processing and routing
Order, invoice, or claim orchestration across systems

reliability: Dead-lettering on integration queues prevents message loss
Premium Service Bus with zone redundancy in prod
security: Service Bus local auth disabled; connector uses managed identity
No public blob access on the runtime storage account
costOptimization: WS1 plan and Standard Service Bus in dev
Elastic Workflow Standard plan scales with workflow load
operationalExcellence: Workflow run history and metrics in Application Insights / Log Analytics
Workflows and infrastructure versioned together as code
performanceEfficiency: Decoupled queues smooth bursty integration traffic
Plan SKU scales for higher workflow concurrency

cost.profile: Prod profile: WS3 Workflow Standard plan, Premium Service Bus.

components.name: Runtime storage (LRS)
components.notes: Workflow run history and content share.
